messages:
Sam H: Quick sync — we need to pick sequencing for Dedicated vs Private investment. Lots of customer pressure + capacity signals. Do we stick to capacity-first, move isolation-first for a few regulated accounts, or run a two-track?
Lee G: leaning capacity-first. clears throughput bottlenecks, lowers unit cost, helps many customers immediately.
Maria P: +1 on capacity for volume but flagging FinSolve and HealthCo — both require VPC/on-prem and are ready to pay. delaying Private loses near-term ARR.
Jon K: Two-track seems safest: short runway to enable a minimal Private offering for top regulated customers while we scale Dedicated capacity. but that doubles product ops surface.
Anika R: We promised a RICE-style re-score last week. I ran a quick pass and pasted the numbers below. rough numbers, but helps conversation.
Anika R: ```
Initiative: Dedicated capacity 2.0
Reach: 4000 daily requests (Q1)
Impact (qual): 7 (reduces p95 by 30%)
Confidence: 60%
Effort: 6 person-months
RICE score ~ (4000*7*0.6)/6 = 2800

Initiative: Private VPC MVP
Reach: 50 enterprise customers
Impact: 9 (enables compliance deals)
Confidence: 50%
Effort: 8 person-months
RICE score ~ (50*9*0.5)/8 = 281
```
Sam H: So numerically Dedicated wins (orders of magnitude) but private has strategic value and ARR attached. RICE is skewed by reach. we discussed weighting strategic impact earlier.
Lee G: Can we adjust RICE by adding a "strategic multiplier" for regulatory/compliance value? e.g., x3 for deals that unblock $X ARR and SOC2+ requirements.
Maria P: I don't love ad-hoc multipliers unless we calibrate. instead propose separate "strategic bucket" review for anything that meets 1) regulatory blocker 2) >$250k ARR pipeline. those get expedited Private track.
Jon K: Operational cost of two-track: +1 on infra complexity, +1.5 sprint overhead. We should quantify run-rate ops before committing.
Anika R: launch gating ideas:
- Private MVP: 1) network isolation (VPC peering), 2) KMS integration, 3) audit log to SIEM.
- Dedicated 2.0: autoscale headroom to 2x p95, transparent per-route cost breakdown, and canary fallback to cheaper variant.
product-bot: CustomerRequest: FinSolve submitted a security questionnaire and marked Private deployment as a gating requirement for procurement. ticket #FS-493.
Sam H: Ok next steps proposal:
1) short spike (2 wks) to prototype Private MVP networking and KMS (eng-ml + infra) to validate effort.
2) parallel sprint to accelerate Dedicated capacity improvements (autoscale + batching).
3) Sales/product to run Strategic Bucket review weekly; if a customer meets criteria (Maria's rules) we greenlight Private fast-track.
Sam H: Please react with one of: "capacity-first", "isolation-first", or "two-track" and add a short line if you want to veto. Trying to get a quorum by EOD. :clock3:
Lee G: :thumbsup: capacity-first
Maria P: :thumbsup: two-track — will add HealthCo + FinSolve to strategic review doc.
Jon K: two-track (but add explicit ops run-rate calc)
Anika R: two-track (agree with spike + gated roll)
Sam H: thanks everyone — capturing notes and scheduling the spike kickoff for Monday.
